label: The Ghost Liner
summary: A luxury liner lost sixty years ago drifts out of the Tallow Drift with its lights on. Whoever docks first owns it.
title: The Ghost Liner
description: The Halcyon Crown, a luxury liner that vanished with two thousand passengers sixty years ago, has just drifted out of the deep Drift with its lights on and its music playing. Salvage law says whoever docks first owns it. The Second Chance is closest. The crew is broke. Nobody wants to say what they are thinking.

chapterOutlines.title: The Signal
chapterOutlines.outline: Pick up the Halcyon Crown's signal and race other crews to it.

chapterOutlines.title: The Grand Ballroom
chapterOutlines.outline: Board the liner and explore its impossible, perfectly kept halls.

chapterOutlines.title: The Passengers
chapterOutlines.outline: Find out where two thousand people went, and why the music never stops.

chapterOutlines.title: Salvage Rights
chapterOutlines.outline: Get the prize, or your lives, back to Gristle Station.

scene.location: The cramped bridge of the salvage tug Second Chance, deep in the Tallow Drift
scene.summary: The proximity alarm is chiming. On the screen, a liner the size of a city drifts out of the dark, every window lit, and the radio is playing a waltz.

openThreads: Who else is racing for the salvage?
Why is the music getting louder?

npcs.name: Captain Mags Okonkwo
npcs.description: The tug's captain and owner, a cheerful gambler who owes money to every station in the Drift.
abilities: Flies through debris like it is a dance

npcs.name: BOLT
npcs.description: The ship's maintenance robot, built from three other robots, with a nervous personality and a vacuum attachment it is very proud of.
goals: Keep the ship in one piece

npcs.name: Vesna Kade
npcs.description: Captain of the Iron Magpie, a rival crew. Ruthless, stylish and always one step ahead.

items.name: Plasma cutter
items.description: Cuts through bulkheads, locks and, carefully, nothing else.

items.name: Patch kit
items.description: Seals a hole in a suit or a hull. Smells of burnt glue.

items.name: Salvage claim beacon
items.description: Stick it on a wreck and it is legally yours. Probably.
